summary: Allbirds filed an 8-K/A to amend a prior 8-K, disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement to issue up to $50M in senior secured convertible notes to an institutional investor. Proceeds will fund a subsidiary's purchase of electronics assets. The notes are convertible into Class A common stock, subject to shareholder approval under Nasdaq rules for issuances exceeding 19.99%. The investor also gets a 24-month co-investment right for 55% of future financings. The filing suggests a shift toward electronics, likely a pivot from apparel. Watch for shareholder vote at the special meeting; risk includes dilution and conversion mechanics.
